sloka: तस्यैवं ब्रुवतो राजा मन्दासुर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।किं शक्यमिह कर्तुं वै कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः ।। ७.१९.२६ ॥
transliteration: tasyaivaṁ bruvato rājā mandāsurvākyamabravīt ।kiṁ śakyamiha kartuṁ vai kālo hi duratikramaḥ ।। 7.19.26 ॥

translations.english: O king of men, there is no one in the three worlds who can challenge me; I suspect you are too engrossed in pleasures to know my strength.
